description: This PHP source file defines a REST API class 'DataGroupAPI' within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class provides an endpoint for retrieving data group permissions, adhering to the project's API architecture and implementing methods for CRUD operations, many of which are not yet implemented.

classes.name: DataGroupAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing data group permissions within the OrangeHRM system, supporting retrieval of all data groups but not supporting create or delete operations yet.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of data group permissions via the UserRoleManager.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules (empty in this case) for the 'getAll' request.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Method intended for creating a data group, currently not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creation, currently not implemented.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method intended for deleting a data group, currently not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for delete, currently not implemented.
